title: Lost Mary BM600 Strawberry Kiwi Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Strawberry Kiwi pairs the soft sweetness of ripe Strawberry with the tangy brightness of Kiwi for a fruity vape that’s both smooth and zesty. The blend is well-balanced, with the mellow Strawberry laying a sweet foundation and the Kiwi adding a lively twist. It’s an easy-going yet flavourful profile ideal for all-day vaping. These pods are designed for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit. Each 2ml pod contains 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, providing a smooth MTL (mouth-to-lung) draw and fast-acting nicotine satisfaction. Each pod delivers up to 600 puffs depending on usage. Once a pod is finished, simply replace it with a new one to continue enjoying your chosen flavour.
